purpose: Isolate the nine-candidate state-interaction operation and test whether full interaction reproduces independent conditional mixture moments and conserves the combined fifteen-state mean and covariance under identity dynamics.
repairs_from_v01: Apply the finite-value gate to all twenty-four numeric arrays saved in evidence rather than ten selected dynamic arrays.
Record the complete checked-array name list and any non-finite array names in the certificate and summary.
Compare the factorial transition matrix with the independently frozen literal factor probabilities 0.98 and 0.01.
Update the core estimator documentation to name all three interaction modes and its legacy default.

parameter_source.source_basin_description: the first frozen formal basin, used only to freeze the existing three complete parameter labels

state_scale_interpretation: positive synthetic coordinate scales in the common physical units of the five storage states and ten routing-memory states; they do not represent a hydrologic trajectory or a parameter-specific state
random_initialization_rule: independent seed streams generate strictly positive candidate probabilities, positive synthetic state coordinates and positive-definite candidate covariances before identity-dynamics interaction
independent_reference_rule: direct destination-by-destination loops recompute conditional source weights, means and full covariances without calling the production interaction helper
counterexample_rule: the parameter-factor marginal starts at 0.80, 0.15 and 0.05; the first state coordinate is 0, 5 and 10 by parameter group; full, parameter-grouped and no-interaction modes receive the same thirty probability transitions and identity dynamics
scope_limit: This component validates conditional state and covariance mixture algebra under identity dynamics. The frozen parameter vectors and process-noise matrices define the nine labels but do not generate the synthetic states. It cannot establish hydrologic propagation accuracy, filtering benefit, likelihood calibration or forecast improvement.
